body.name: s_HMS
body.def: \(s_{\mathrm{HMS}}\) is the maximum directed indegree in Hollering, Misra, and Sturma's Propositions 7.2--7.4; the proposal uses their specialization \(s_{\mathrm{HMS}}=2\). Propositions 7.2 and 7.3 give \(2s_{\mathrm{HMS}}+1\) for the half-trek and instrumental-cutset subclasses, and Proposition 7.4 gives \(s_{\mathrm{HMS}}^4+2s_{\mathrm{HMS}}^3+s_{\mathrm{HMS}}^2\) for the auxiliary-cutset subclass.
